2.def: One leads to another (lit. from one another)

3.item: καὶ γνώσεσθε τὴν ἀλήθειαν, καὶ ἡ ἀλήθεια ἐλευθερώσει ὑμᾶς.
3.def: kai gnōsesthe tēn alētheian, kai hē alētheia eleutherōsei hymas / and you will know the truth, and the truth will set you free

4.item: Adhuc loquor. Permite mihi finire, quaeso.
4.def: I am still speaking. Allow me to finish, please.
